== deinterlace-yadif=send_field
(no invocation)
error: deinterlace "yadif=send_field" emits one frame per FIELD, which would double the output's frame count: refusing to encode. Packet-count parity and duration parity are graded against the SOURCE's frame count, so such an output could only be accepted by weakening a gate that stands in front of the deletion of a source
== deinterlace-yadif=send_field_nospatial
(no invocation)

Packet-count parity and duration parity are graded against the SOURCE's frame count, so such an output could only be accepted by weakening a gate that stands in front of the deletion of a source

== deinterlace-kerndeint
(no invocation)
error: deinterlace "kerndeint" is not a value this build can resolve to a filter (known: [off yadif yadif=<mode> bwdif bwdif=<mode>]), so nothing was encoded

(no invocation)
